newsitem.title: INDIA: Five guerrillas, one soldier killed in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Five guerrillas, one soldier killed in Kashmir.

text.p: Indian security forces on Friday killed five separatist guerrillas who had crossed the border from Pakistan into Kashmir, a defence spokesman said.
The spokesman said one soldier was also killed in the clash.
"A group of heavily armed militants infiltrated from the Pakistan occupied Kashmir and five of them were killed in an encounter in Nowgaum sector in Kupwara district," the spokesman said.
Nowgaum sector lies on India's border with Pakistan in Kupwara district, 85 km (55 miles) north of the state's summer capital Srinagar.
It was the fourth clash in the heavily wooded region in the last month. Over a dozen groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Jammu and Kashmir, India's only Moslem- majority state.
India accuses Pakistan of arming Kashmiri militants, but Islamabad says it only provides political and diplomatic support to separatists. India controls two-thirds of Kashmir and Pakistan the rest.
Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed in a seven-year-old rebllion. The opposition says the toll is nearer to 50,000.
